own_round.note: this script and the protocol it ships with name the blocks by design

audit.rule: an executed artefact cannot be un-seen, a registered seed cannot be un-claimed, and a declared range is a promise the project has already made. Any hit stops the round; the block is never moved to make the audit pass.

scope.note: narrowed to the blocks this run may still create; a seed this project has already recorded is not a claim on a seed it has not, and narrowing is not a whitelist -- every hit inside the audited block still stops the round

coverage.note: file names carry the seed; 47 GB of per-episode JSONL is never opened

audit.verdict: zero overlap across all four sources: the blocks may be registered and recorded

layer.granted_by: the user's explicit order of 2026-09-23, recorded in COMM_TASK_PRESSURE_G12_EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md §2

evidence.harness_agreement_provenance: inherited: this layer was licensed by the delivered round's AGREEMENT_GATE.json, which ran under CODE_FREEZE.json. The extension may not spend new verification episodes, so the probe counters it added are proven transparent by zero-episode tests, and the runner needs no new gate because this layer's freeze names the same episode code identity the delivered layers do
evidence.note_on_refusals: a fixed rule being refused is the credit binding, which is what L3 asks for; L0 only requires that the transcript and the relay agree about how often it happened

L0.meaning: the layer's data, ledger and interface are trustworthy enough to be judged at all

L1.meaning: the layer's targets are actually being found, so a communication gate is not measuring a search hole

evidence.reading_if_above_band: effect ceiling: communication already buys nearly everything
evidence.reading_if_below_band: capacity/search floor: sending cannot recover the tasks

L2.meaning: the uplink still buys tasks, and the best rule is neither at the floor nor at the ceiling, so a cost/effect trade-off can exist at all

evidence.definition_of_a_point: visible candidates >= 2 and 1 <= payable < visible at the step's opening credit

L3.meaning: the budget is binding in a way that forces selection among candidates the sender can see

evidence.envelope_definition: per-stream maximum of the seven budgeted competitors on on-time targets, ties broken towards fewer bytes; an experience bound, not a deployable strategy
evidence.note: L4 is a necessary-condition signal only: it says fixed rules cannot cover the measured situations uniformly. It does not show a network could learn the envelope.

L4.meaning: there is situation-dependent value that no single fixed rule in the library captures

gates.stop_reason: L2/L3/L4 not all passed and the data is sound: proceed to the next layer

explained_differences.belief_age: the rule emitted nothing, so no robot-target pair was ever informed: this round keeps that as an explicit absence while round 5's renderer wrote `... or 0.0`. Same episode, two renderings of the same empty set.

agreement.note: config_hash is not part of the agreement: it folds the transcript path into the hash, so a different directory must change it (round 10 established this). The compared quantities are task outcome, money, emissions, refusals, deliveries and belief age.

best_fixed_rule.rule: most on-time per episode; tie to fewer bytes; tie to the protocol's row order

bootstrap_audit.rule: one call per (layer, axis, baseline); every CI in the report is sliced from it
